note: Global site header -- renders: Booking.com logo, language/currency selector, sign-in controls, and fixed navigation tabs (Accommodations, Flights, Packages, Cars, Attractions, Airport taxis)
Search bar widget -- renders: destination input, date picker, occupancy selector, and search button
Breadcrumb navigation -- renders: fixed site hierarchy links (Home, Hotels, City, District, Property Name)
Property detail tabs -- renders: Overview, Availability, Facilities, Policies, Fine print, Reviews
Booking action bar -- renders: wishlist toggle, share button, Book Now button, and price guarantee link
Property title header -- renders: property name, star rating, and location badge
Map widget controls -- renders: map view toggle and location pin
Availability section chrome -- renders: date summary, price guarantee, and search controls
Room availability table -- renders: room types, bed configurations, prices, cancellation policies, and booking controls
Facilities section -- renders: property amenities and features
Policies section -- renders: check-in/check-out times, house rules, and booking conditions
Important information section -- renders: property-specific notices and requirements
FAQ section -- renders: frequently asked questions about the property
Site footer -- renders: navigation links, legal information, and language/currency selectors
User survey widget -- renders: platform-authored survey question and fixed response options
